evidence.quote: I thought it would be a good occasion to step back and assess where we stand in our post-crisis efforts to promote financial stability in the United States.
But I do not think there is a sound economic case for generally weakening the regulatory requirements applicable to the largest banks.
For example, I would raise the threshold for enhanced prudential standards from its current $50 billion level, perhaps to $100 billion.
